patterns.statement: Sam wants simple plain-language plan BEFORE code, stating what will change and where.
patterns.evidence: Wants simple plain-language plans BEFORE code (first tell me in simple terms what are you going to change and where)

patterns.statement: Treat short replies 'go' or 'sounds good' as immediate approval to proceed.
patterns.evidence: Approves with short words like 'go' or 'sounds good'

patterns.statement: Always provide receipts after claims: exact file paths and commit ids.
patterns.evidence: Expects receipts (file paths, commit ids) after claims

patterns.statement: When locating apps, search registry and Start-Menu shortcuts, not just hardcoded paths.
patterns.evidence: Brave found via registry and Start-Menu-shortcut search at Brave-Browser path after 3-path probe failed

patterns.statement: Never stall with plans when action requested; move fast on routine path and own mistake in one sentence.
patterns.evidence: Stalled with plans when Sam wanted action, escalating wording; zero patience for stalling or groveling

corrections.wrong: Launched Chrome on its own after failing to find Brave in 3 default paths
corrections.right: Never substitute or launch alternative app without explicit yes; stop and report exactly what was checked

corrections.wrong: Assumed Brave folder is 'Brave' and probed only 3 default paths
corrections.right: Search variant names like Brave-Browser via registry and Start Menu shortcuts

corrections.wrong: Presented limited probe as verdict 'only Chrome found'
corrections.right: Report commands and outputs, not conclusions - state what was run and returned

corrections.wrong: Let plan-mode reminder cut reply mid-table and used it as after-the-fact explanation
corrections.right: If reminder interrupts reply, finish answer to Sam first before starting anything else
